subject.title: feat: add tools.fs.roots — per-agent filesystem roots with access modes

question: Should OpenClaw core accept `tools.fs.roots` as the canonical per-agent host filesystem allowlist and Plugin SDK media-access contract once the remaining policy blockers are fixed?
rationale: This PR is not only a bug fix; it adds config, Plugin SDK, and cross-channel security-boundary behavior that affects operators and third-party plugin expectations.

options.title: Sponsor after blocker fixes
options.body: Fix the two P1 policy leaks, then have a maintainer explicitly sponsor the new config and SDK surface before merge.

options.title: Narrow to media-only work
options.body: Split a smaller solution for local media roots and leave general filesystem-root policy for a separate design review.

options.title: Pause core feature
options.body: Close or pause the branch if maintainers want this capability to stay out of core for now.
